run_model_training: run detectron2 model training from a LazyConfig Python config file with multi-GPU DDP support
run_model_evaluation: run evaluation of a trained detectron2 model on a test dataset using LazyConfig
run_resume_training: resume detectron2 training from a saved checkpoint using the LazyConfig training script
review_do_train: review the do_train function that instantiates models, optimizers, dataloaders, and registers training hooks
review_do_test: review the do_test function that runs inference on a dataset and prints results in CSV format
